**`Weather.java`** — Changed the `recentWeather` field type from `ArrayList<WeatherType>` to `List<WeatherType>` (still instantiated as `ArrayList`). Removed stale inline comments: `// define fields`, `// reset`, `// If in the last 4 weathers...`, `// Adds to the end of the list,`, `// remove from the start of the list`.

**`Randomizer.java`** — Removed the dead `useShared` flag. It was `private static final boolean useShared = true`, so the compiler permanently dead-codes the `else` branches in `getRandom()` and `reset()`. Both methods now return/use `rand` directly. The empty no-arg constructor (which did nothing) is also gone.

**`FieldStats.java`** — The `counts` field is now declared as `Map<Class<?>, Integer>` instead of `HashMap<Class<?>, Integer>`. Always program to the interface at declaration sites.
